verdict.rationale: Cake documents a general permissions feature where 'admin controls exactly what they can see' outside the full cap table (docs-14), suggesting some scoped-access capability exists, but there is no evidence of dedicated third-party professional access (law firm, HRIS vendor, wealth manager) roles, API keys, or scoped credential systems built for this specific use case. Missing for 10: named integrations or role types for external professionals, API/token-based scoped access, and documentation of granular permission levels beyond the generic stakeholder portal distinction.
